title: Extraction provider boundary + common mechanical verifier
objective: Create the provider seam required to compare extraction architectures without choosing deterministic versus LLM yet: place the current adbfc37 RoleIntelligence and CandidateProof deterministic extraction behind explicit provider adapters, define an equivalent non-authoritative LLM provider contract, and establish one shared fail-closed mechanical verifier for immutable source identity, exact spans, schema/ontology validity, normalization, deduplication, deterministic metric normalization where appropriate, and input/cache identity.
mustNotChange: deterministic Extraction V1 output semantics or frozen-baseline behavior
production extraction authority remains the existing deterministic baseline
no Batch 03 LLM experiment implementation or production LLM switch
requiredVerification: deterministic provider adapter parity against the current/frozen RoleIntelligence and CandidateProof baseline tests

shared verifier tests covering immutable source-reference enforcement, exact source/span resolution, schema/ontology rejection, normalization/deduplication, deterministic metric normalization where applicable, input/cache identity, and fail-closed behavior
prove the provider/verifier boundary cannot bypass Batch 01 immutable source identities
build/certification only when required by the touched contract boundary; prefer targeted tests during development
acknowledge every governed implementation/test/substantive transition-documentation commit in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
completionEvidence: explicit RoleIntelligence and CandidateProof extraction provider interfaces/adapters exist
deterministic adapters reproduce the existing deterministic baseline without semantic drift
an equivalent LLM provider contract exists but no Batch 03 LLM experiment is implemented or production-authoritative
one common mechanical verifier rejects unresolvable immutable sources/spans, invalid schema/ontology values, and other mechanically invalid provider output fail-closed
provider input/cache identity is deterministic and bound to immutable source identity plus provider/schema configuration
production continues to use the existing deterministic baseline unchanged
all governed commits made during the batch are acknowledged in the transition implementation ledger
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly; do not bypass the transition verifier. Batch 03 is not authorized by this manifest.
